name: voice-desktop-app
description: An electron shell wrapper for the google voice app

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app requires microphone access to capture your voice while on calls.

scripts.build:windows: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.build:windows:web: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --win nsis-web --x64
scripts.build:windows:offline: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.build:x64: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --mac --windows --linux --x64
scripts.build:arm64: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --mac --windows --linux --arm64
scripts.release:windows: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && dotenv -e .env -- electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish always
scripts.release:windows:web: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && dotenv -e .env -- electron-builder --win nsis-web --x64 --publish always
scripts.release:linux: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && wsl -d Ubuntu bash -lc "/mnt/g/Custom_Projects/Custom_Apps/google-voice-desktop-app/scripts/release-linux-wsl.sh"
scripts.release: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --windows --linux --x64 --arm64 --publish always
scripts.build:windows:small: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run build:themes && electron-builder --win nsis-web --x64

author: jllankfo@ncsu.edu
